scope: Independent source and development-component review only

findings.title: Terminal reconciliation accepts a different host's configuration as proof of the original command
findings.trigger: Start host.configure against logical host A, hold its HTTP reply, switch discovery to B with a different native host_instance_id and data_dir, then release A's reply. B already has a record with the same five payload fields and config revision. For the STALE_RESPONSE branch, remount while the original request is in flight; for the COMPLETED branch, keep the component mounted.
findings.observed: Both independent actual-DOM scenarios display configuration saved and unlock the form after reading B. In the STALE_RESPONSE scenario B even uses a different model_config_ref. B receives only host.status and no host.configure. The original command identity is therefore discharged by evidence from another host.
findings.cause: The renderer pending entry is keyed only by projectId and does not carry the shell's trusted hostKey. IPC checks hostKey only before send/replay and releases the operation when the old host returns terminal success. reconcile then reads whichever host discovery currently selects; host equality is never checked. The COMPLETED branch additionally checks only matching model_config_ref in host.status, rather than all five fields and revision.
findings.impact: A host/data-root switch during an in-flight command can produce a false current-host saved result and discard the original-host intent, despite the new replay guard. The user is allowed to proceed based on a record unrelated to the issued command.
findings.requested_change: Retain a trusted immutable origin binding with the terminal command until reconciliation. Reconcile only against that same logical host and data root, with exact configuration identity/fields/revision; a host switch must preserve the unresolved original-host intent. Port/PID changes within the same logical host may remain legitimate. Do not infer origin from a matching payload, model reference or renderer-supplied flag, and do not create a new command to recover an uncertain result.

verified_repairs: W05-UI-V2-001 in-flight remount on the same host is repaired: the replacement component observes terminal state and only one host.configure reaches HTTP.
Whitespace correction and already-ACKNOWLEDGED component remount remain repaired; replay retains the entire original envelope and command_id.
Project A to B to A preserves the original pending command, blocks a changed write on B and allows the original replay on A.
An unprovable STALE_RESPONSE retains locked inputs and the recheck action sends no second configure.

Native host instance/data-root changes before replay and during credential acquisition are refused, preserving the prior barrier where applicable. Returning to the original logical host with a different PID allows replay.
NOT_SENT remains a local pre-POST fact; possiblySent and ACK remain monotonic across later local refusal or credential loss. Active-session writer/CAS scope and all-null initial scope remain correct.
The old partial-scope test now uses a genuinely partial active-session tuple and passes without altering the all-null initial-configuration behavior.

validation.input_verification: 1112/1112: author receipt manifest/files, three v3 delta source files against Git, and frozen v2 validator binary/resource modules. This is not v3 full build-input binding.
validation.independent_execution_of_frozen_author_d: 5/5 passed; inherited script is copied into the review directory and executed against current frozen v3 source
validation.independently_authored_host_race_dom: 2/2 negative counterexamples reproduced, both with one configure request only to A and successful saved UI after status from B
validation.v3_full_binding_build: NOT_RUN; source-level failures are already decisive, so no full input copy or new large build was performed
validation.uncertain_newer_configuration: Existing STALE_RESPONSE exact revision/field matching conservatively retains intent if no exact record exists. A matching record on a different host is the reproduced exception. COMPLETED reconciliation's reference-only proof is included in the finding.

history: Initial preparation attempted to snapshot the full Main-to-v3 delta from the sparse worktree and stopped at missing tests/ui/continuity/surfaces_driver.js. This was an audit preparation error before tests, not a product result. Verification was narrowed to the three actual v3 delta files while inherited files remain covered by earlier reviews; no missing file was treated as empty or PASS.
The boundary, baseline DOM and independent host-race runs all exited 0. Host-race exit 0 means assertions successfully reproduced the defects, not candidate acceptance.
limitations: Tests run v3 JavaScript/React with the frozen v2 Go validator. No v3 complete exact-module/source input release binding is claimed.
Native credential delivery, physical Electron startup, real Core transitions and real user data-root replacement were not exercised. Host discovery and HTTP servers are controlled public fixtures.
Whole renderer process restart recovery remains the author's declared limitation. No new pending-query API or persistence mechanism was assumed.
